description: This is a code-behind file for an ASP.NET Web Forms page named EditExam.aspx, containing event handlers for button clicks that transfer control to different pages within the OnlineExamSystem project.

classes.name: EditExam
classes.description: Partial class for the code-behind of the EditExam Web Form, handling page load and button click events for navigation within the online examination system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler called when the page loads; currently, no implementation.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the home button click; transfers to AdminPanel.aspx.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the profile button; transfers to AdminQueue.aspx.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the leaderboard button; transfers to AdminLeaderboard.aspx.

methods.name: eTheoryB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for editing theory questions; transfers to EditTheory.aspx.

methods.name: eMcqB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for editing MCQ questions; transfers to EditMCQ.aspx.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for logout button; transfers to LoginPage.aspx.
